name: By the roads of Hallownest
source:
The beetle adventurer, having heard the story of the feat of the nameless Knight who defeated the plague in the kingdom of Hallownest, decided to come travel around Hallownest.

[From [url=https://nibeon.itch.io/by-the-roads-of-hallownest]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
甲虫冒险家听说了圣巢王国中无名骑士战胜瘟疫的壮举，决定来圣巢各地旅行。

[来自[url=https://nibeon.itch.io/by-the-roads-of-hallownest]itch.io[/url]]
